<thought>The mass spectrum shows a base peak at m/z 262.0994, which in positive‑mode ESI corresponds to [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈261.0921 Da. Using the isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈ 20 % of M) suggests about 18 carbons. A formula that matches the exact mass is C₁₈H₁₃O₂ (calc. 261.0916 Da, Δ ≈ 0.0005 Da). This fits both the mass and the observed isotope intensity.</thought>
<final_answer>C18H13O2</final_answer>
